item.title: Oakland's own Alysa Liu captures Olympic gold for Women's figure skating
item.description: Oakland's own Alysa Liu has captured the gold medal in women's singles figure skating at the Olympics. It's the first individual gold in women's figure skating for a member of Team USA since 2002. Oakland's own Gold medal OlympianIt's an Olympic journey that is making her hometown proud. At a watch party at the Oakland Ice Center on Thursday, they're savoring 20-year-old Liu's victory, and they couldn't have been prouder. Fans and friends say she often trains at the Oakland facility.
